baselineScope: Immediately preceding ADR-0499 cached implementation, using saved pre-memory-slice query, JSON persistence, tuple field cache and ranker; all earlier speed improvements shared

protocol.processes: a separate fresh Node process for every arm
protocol.cacheIsolation: independent cache directories per arm; no format eviction across arms
protocol.preparedMemory: process.memoryUsage immediately after prepare; not peak or post-GC retained size
protocol.competingWorkloads: no agent tests or builds during measurements; other host activity uncontrolled
protocol.supplementalSources: captured once before cold runs; collection excluded
protocol.bootstrapMs: Node performance clock before prepare, including module loading and frozen input read; process launch overhead is included only in processWallMs
protocol.preparationMs: includes projection reads, fresh source/publication reads, extraction, impact, preparation, and projection writes
protocol.queryMs: six complete queries after each preparation
protocol.maxRssKiB: child process peak RSS through result digest, includes bootstrap and queries
protocol.processWallMs: parent wall clock around child launch through exit, includes result digest
protocol.scanEquality: one additional complete baseline/cached scan comparison after timing, not included in timings
protocol.digestEncoding: SHA-256 of compact JSON.stringify for scans, responses, supplemental sources and baseline source strings; runner and query probe hashes use raw UTF-8 bytes
protocol.reportFinalization: Runtime implementation was frozen during measurement. A legacy-format test fixture and reporting documents were finalized afterward; the recorded snapshot identifies the measured corpus.

privacy: No source bodies, raw queries, host identities, or paths outside the repository are retained.
